items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Indian equities appear set for gradual gains, supported by encouraging news. Growing hopes for peace in West Asia and solid Q1FY27 earnings are enhancing investor confidence. Brent crude prices have fallen below eighty dollars per barrel, reflecting optimism in talks. The market will keep an eye on crucial Q1 earnings and US employment figures as the Indian rupee slightly weakened against the dollar on Thursday.

items.title: Weekly Expiry: Sensex mirrors Nifty's swings, but with milder spurts
items.description: The recent weekly expiry of Sensex showcased unexpected surges in the index and heightened options premiums. Traders observe that such fluctuations are now standard until liquidity conditions improve. Notably, substantial implied volatility spikes arose without impactful news. Significant trades in ICICI Bank hinted at efforts to sway the index's trajectory. This market landscape creates challenges for option writers while benefiting buyers.

items.title: Stock Radar: RVNL showing signs of reversal after falling over 40% from highs; time to buy?
items.description: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited stock shows early bullish reversal signs near 220.  Experts suggest buying for a target above 250 in coming weeks.  The stock has reclaimed its 20-day moving average and is near the 50-DMA.  A breakout above 233 could signal a fresh bullish leg for the stock.  Traders can consider a stop loss below 218 on a closing basis.

items.title: These large and mid-cap stocks can give more than 20% return in 1 year, according to analysts
items.description: Whenever there is a correction or volatility, just ask one question: Is it an opportunity, or should one be wary? We are raising this issue at this juncture because, after a phase of volatility, there is some indication that fund flows are getting better. So, as an investor, make sure you don’t miss the big picture, which means you should reduce the element of fear in decision-making. But, at the same time, don’t be complacent. More mistakes are made in that frame of mind.

items.title: Sebi takes up 402 investigation cases in FY26; completes 338
items.description: Sebi investigated 402 cases in 2025-26 for securities law violations.  Fraudulent and unfair trade practices saw 121 cases taken up for scrutiny.  Insider trading and illegal trade practices accounted for 224 investigations initiated.  Financial statement fraud also came under regulatory focus with 57 cases.  Market intermediaries underwent increased surveillance with over 900 brokers inspected.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
items.description: Indian markets found support from easing crude oil prices and the RBI's stable policy outlook despite range-bound trade. Analysts said Nifty holding above 24,600 keeps bullish momentum intact, with improving earnings expectations and stock-specific buying supporting broader market resilience.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Tata Technologies among 2 stock recommendations for Friday
items.description: Nifty ended nearly flat after a range-bound session but stayed above key moving averages, preserving its bullish trend. Analysts recommended Tata Technologies and AIIL as buy ideas, citing breakout patterns, strong momentum, rising volumes and favourable technical indicators for further upside.

items.title: Traders blink! India's stock investors choose Warren Buffett-style ownership in volatile FY26
items.description: Indian investors favoured long-term stock ownership in FY26 as delivery ratios rose to around 30%, despite market volatility. Sebi said stronger domestic inflows, expanding demat accounts and reduced derivatives speculation reflected healthier participation and greater resilience amid foreign investor outflows.

items.title: Tata Sons faces continued listing uncertainty after RBI classification
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India has placed Tata Sons under intensified regulatory oversight. This designation will not influence its ongoing bid to relinquish its NBFC license. Tata Sons had cleared its debts and sought deregistration approximately two years ago. The regulator is expected not to mandate a listing until the application is resolved, which, in turn, affects the philanthropic ventures and investments of Tata Trusts.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: A leading small finance bank and a mid-cap capital goods stock, both for a gain of about 6%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: Faster AIF schemes to corporate bonds tokenisation: What Sebi annual report tells about its next moves
items.description: Sebi will introduce fast-track Alternative Investment Fund launches, a single-window clearance system and the Sebi Setu portal to ease compliance. It also plans corporate bond tokenisation pilots, quantum-ready technology roadmaps and Project Jagrook to strengthen investor awareness and market efficiency.

items.title: Sebi proposes separate master circular for clearing corporations
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) is set to refine regulations for stock exchanges and clearing corporations. There will be a distinct master circular for clearing entities, alongside enhanced website disclosure obligations. Additionally, existing provisions regarding stock brokers are to be eliminated from current master circulars. This initiative seeks to unify standards and ease the regulatory landscape.

items.title: Sebi proposes investment by REITs, InvITs in third party projects without controlling interest
items.description: Sebi has put forth proposals to permit REITs and InvITs to channel their investments into under-construction projects. This initiative is designed to establish a consistent stream of revenue-producing assets over the long term. Moreover, the regulator plans to shorten the cooling-off period for privately placed InvITs. Notably, common remote infrastructure will now be classified as real estate for REITs.

items.title: SBI Q1 results preview: Will India's largest public bank report a decline in profit?
items.description: In the upcoming June quarter, State Bank of India's profits are projected to dip, influenced by margin constraints and a slowdown in income growth. Analysts foresee a decrease in net interest margins despite vigorous loan activity. With deposit growth expected to trail behind credit expansion, this could prevent any recovery in margins, though asset quality seems likely to remain stable with consistent credit expenditures.

items.title: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On August 6, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 4% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. "RSI trending up" means that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) is rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock's price. This may indicate potential upward movement and can be used by traders to identify buying opportunities.

items.title: Swiggy’s ₹60,000 crore breakeven challenge: Can Instamart grow without restarting the cash war?
items.description: Swiggy's Instamart is targeting an impressive ₹60,000 crore in annualised net order value to achieve profitability. To reach this goal, the platform must double its current orders and enhance contribution margins significantly. This means Instamart should aim to garner an additional ₹30 per order through various optimizations. However, the competitive advantage of Blinkit's size and profitability poses a formidable challenge amid the ongoing balancing act of growth and economic recovery.

items.title: Stocks to buy in 2026 for long term: Bharti Airtel, Clean Max among 5 stocks that could give 10-50% return
items.description: Brokerages remain constructive on a diverse set of stocks across telecom, energy, retail and clean energy, with several names offering double-digit return potential based on their latest target pricesWe have collated a list of recommendations from top brokerage firms from ETNow and other sources:

items.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy Jio Financial, Indus Towers among 9 stocks for dividend payouts. Do you own any?
items.description: Jio Financial Services fixed August 10 as the record date for its final dividend of Rs 0.60 per share for the financial year which ended on March 31, 2026. This comes after the company paid a dividend of Rs 0.5 per share to its shareholders last year.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 7 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, 7 stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on August 6, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Traders use the 200-day daily moving average (DMA) as a key indicator to determine the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: LIC Q1 profit surges 23% on growth in value of new business
items.description: Life Insurance Corporation of India reported a twenty-three percent net profit rise. Value of new business jumped sixty-one percent, boosting profitability margins significantly. Diversification into non-participating savings and protection products aided this strong performance. The insurer's solvency ratio strengthened, and assets under management also increased. Government's recent offer for sale was well received by the market.

items.title: Indian rupee weakens slightly against dollar amid importer demand, oil prices cool
items.description: The Indian rupee weakened slightly against the dollar on Thursday as importers continued to push for dollar purchases. Although oil prices showed signs of easing, this did not provide enough support for the rupee. Throughout the session, the currency was observed trading in a range of 95.10 to 95.24 per dollar, with Brent crude prices remaining under $80 a barrel.

items.title: RBI relaxes device-loan recovery norms
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India has updated its regulations on mobile loan financing. Lenders are now required to reinstate device functionality within one hour of confirmation of payment. Additionally, borrower compensation is limited to the total loan amount. These regulations will take effect starting January 1, 2027. Furthermore, technology may be employed to limit device functions following a loan default.

items.title: Coal India Ltd preferred bidder for Odisha iron ore block
items.description: Coal India Limited has become the preferred bidder for Odisha's Gadadharpur iron ore block.  The state-owned miner will diversify operations by entering the iron ore sector.  This acquisition strengthens Coal India's critical mineral resource presence significantly.  The company aims to expand its revenue base beyond plateauing coal demand.  Further diversification includes renewable energy and thermal power generation projects.

items.title: FPIs, trading companies tap Sebi, centre for tax breather
items.description: Investors from abroad are pressing regulators for a decrease in securities transaction taxes to alleviate the burden of double capital gains taxes. With the Reserve Bank of India's stringent leverage rules potentially pushing trading activities offshore, there's a risk of reduced government revenues and diminished market liquidity. Authorities are considering these issues in light of the recent tax cuts on government securities.

items.title: India to launch digital gold regulatory framework next year
items.description: The Indian government is likely to roll out regulations for digital gold in the coming year, backed by discussions involving critical ministries and the Reserve Bank of India. The Digital Precious Metals Assurance Council of India is playing a pivotal role in this process. The objective is to ensure consumer protection and counteract fraud as the digital gold market expands, inspired by successful models from abroad.

items.title: Banks tone down rate-hike bets as RBI sounds dovish on prices
items.description: Some banks now anticipate fewer policy rate increases from the Reserve Bank of India. Yes Bank and State Bank of India have revised their earlier rate hike forecasts. MUFG Bank has also pushed back its expected policy rate hike timing. Other banks maintain their forecasts for cumulative rate increases this fiscal year. Inflation projections remain sensitive to future crude oil price movements.

items.title: Stocks in news: LIC, Trent, AWL Agri Business, SBI, Titan
items.description: Indian markets experienced a quiet day of trading on weekly expiry, influenced by varying signals. LIC announced a remarkable 23% increase in its net profit year-on-year, while Trent reported a solid 21% growth in consolidated net profit. PNB Housing is optimistic about its micro-housing loan business aiming for Rs 100 crore. Additionally, Dabur has taken legal action against FSSAI's directive concerning its product claims in the Delhi High Court.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp shares jump 3% as Q1 profit rises 29% YoY, beats estimates. What's ahead?
items.description: Hero MotoCorp shares jumped over 3% to Rs 5,739 following strong Q1 FY27 results. The two-wheeler giant reported a 29% YoY rise in standalone net profit to Rs 1,454 crore and a 36% surge in revenue to Rs 12,999 crore, beating market estimates on operational margin performance. Brokerages maintain a Buy call.

items.title: Vikram Solar shares crash 11% to fresh lifetime low. What's spooking investors?
items.description: Vikram Solar shares fell sharply to a record low on Friday after the company reported an 85% year-on-year drop in Q1 profit, with margins shrinking sharply. Investor sentiment was also dented by US President Donald Trump's new 15% tariff on polysilicon products, adding to concerns over the solar sector's global outlook.

items.title: Hindustan Aeronautics among 4 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
items.description: On August 6, four stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the 'White Marubozu' bullish scanner, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period, and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns to assess the potential continuation of upward price momentum.

items.title: Trent shares slide 3% after Q1. What Morgan Stanley, four other brokerages recommend
items.description: Trent shares fell 3% after the Tata Group retailer reported a 21% year-on-year rise in Q1 consolidated net profit to Rs 519 crore. Revenue from operations grew 18% to Rs 5,755 crore. On a sequential basis, net profit increased 25% and revenue rose 14%, although the stock came under pressure despite the earnings growth.

items.title: Siemens Energy India shares jump 7% after strong Q1 results. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Siemens Energy India shares surged over 7% after the company posted a robust June 2026 quarter, with net profit jumping 68% year-on-year and revenue rising nearly 40%. Encouraged by strong execution, a healthy order backlog and long-term growth prospects, Motilal Oswal retained its 'Buy' rating and raised the target price to Rs 4,100.

items.title: Bajaj Finance, Bajaj Finserv shares fall up to 5% on RBI's new proposal for NBFCs
items.description: Shares of Bajaj Finance and Bajaj Finserv fell sharply after the RBI proposed restricting NBFCs to offering only term loans, effectively barring revolving credit products. The proposal exempts NBFCs authorised to issue credit cards and is aimed at strengthening prudential norms while encouraging innovation in lending.

items.title: LIC gains 3% after Q1 earnings. Here's what Morgan Stanley and Motilal Oswal recommend
items.description: LIC shares rose 2.5% after the state-owned insurer reported a 23% year-on-year jump in Q1 standalone net profit to Rs 13,492 crore, while net premium income grew 7% to Rs 1.27 lakh crore. LIC also retained its leadership in the domestic life insurance market, with a 60.1% share of first-year premium income, according to IRDAI data.

items.title: CAS Chaos: Dalal Street's biggest stock trading reform in years endures a rocky first week
items.description: India's recently introduced closing auction system for stock prices is encountering early challenges, with traders raising alarms over erratic price fluctuations and confusion in the marketplace. In response, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) held discussions with brokerages, reassuring them of the system's persistence. The lack of engagement from proprietary and high-frequency traders resulted in decreased liquidity, potentially affecting broker revenues and the volume of derivatives trading.

items.title: Sensex drops over 200 points, Nifty tests 23,600 as Strait of Hormuz tensions rattle oil markets
items.description: Indian stock markets opened lower on Friday as oil prices increased. Concerns over Iran potentially closing the Strait of Hormuz impacted investor sentiment. Bajaj Finance and Bajaj Finserv shares led the declines on the Sensex. IT stocks like TCS and Tech Mahindra bucked the trend with gains. Analysts suggest market consolidation is likely before an eventual upside breakout.

items.title: Britannia shares rally 4% as Q1 profit rises 14% YoY. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Britannia Industries shares rose 4% after the FMCG major reported a more than 14% year-on-year increase in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 591 crore. Despite higher input costs due to geopolitical tensions, the company delivered healthy revenue growth and margin expansion, prompting Nuvama and Nomura to reiterate their 'Buy' ratings on the stock.

items.title: Ola Electric shares jump 31% in 6 months. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Ola Electric shares have rebounded sharply from March lows, supported by improving sentiment, strong sales, and a BESS partnership. Analysts remain cautious, citing execution, competition, and cash-burn risks. Technical indicators suggest resistance near Rs 45–50, with sustained operational improvement seen as essential for further upside.

items.title: Kalyan Jewellers among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of August 6, there was a notable surge in futures open interest for five stocks in the NSE F&O pack, contributing to a total increase in open interest of over 8% as compared to the previous trade. A significant uptick in futures open interest signifies substantial growth in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts for a specific security. This uptrend reflects an increasing number of participants either initiating new positions or expanding existing ones within the futures market.

items.title: FII exodus! Top 10 stocks which saw sharpest decline in foreign capital in Q1. See full list
items.description: While domestic institutional investors are playing an increasingly dominant role in India’s benchmark indices, FIIs continue to pare exposure. Foreign ownership has declined across indices with all of them at the lower end of the 12-quarter range. Here are the top 10 stocks which saw the sharpest fall in FII holding in Q1.

items.title: Kalyan Jewellers shares jump 5% after Jefferies starts coverage with 'Buy'. More upside after 63% rally in 1 month?
items.description: Kalyan Jewellers shares witnessed an uptick on Friday  after Jefferies initiated coverage with a Buy rating and Rs 830 target, implying 39% upside. The stock has rallied 63% in a month. Analysts see further gains, citing strong momentum, franchise-led expansion, healthy returns and improving operating performance.

items.title: Jefferies' Chris Wood sells HDFC Bank, PB Fintech shares to buy 2 new stocks
items.description: Jefferies' Christopher Wood is reshuffling his India long-only model portfolio, dropping HDFC Bank and PB Fintech's PolicyBazaar in favor of Multi Commodity Exchange of India (MCX) and eyewear retailer Lenskart Solutions. The move, detailed in his GREED & fear report, signals a shift toward exchange infrastructure and consumer retail plays.

items.title: Indraprastha Medical Corporation shares surge 9% after Q1FY27 profit rises 9%, revenue grows 11%
items.description: Indraprastha Medical Corporation shares surged over 8.5% to Rs 392.90 following strong Q1FY27 earnings. The healthcare operator reported a 9% YoY increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 56 crore and an 11% rise in revenue to Rs 406 crore. The company also fixed September 18 as the dividend record date.

items.title: Tata Investment, Tata Chemicals rally up to 7% after RBI classifies Tata Sons as upper-layer NBFC
items.description: Tata Investment Corp and Tata Chemicals shares rallied up to 7% after the RBI classified Tata Sons among the 16 upper-layer NBFCs, reviving focus on the holding company's potential listing. The central bank is also examining Tata Sons' application to surrender its core investment company registration.

items.title: Adani Green Energy shares can rally up to 23%. Why Axis Capital, Elara initiated coverage (best)
items.description: Brokerages Axis Capital and Elara Capital initiated coverage on Adani Green Energy, citing its ambitious plan to expand renewable energy capacity to 50 GW and strong long-term growth prospects. The firms see up to 23% upside, backed by robust capacity additions, improving cash flows and India's accelerating clean energy transition.

items.title: Behari Lal Engineering IPO price band set at Rs 271-285, issue opens on August 12
items.description: Behari Lal Engineering will launch its IPO on August 12 with a price band of Rs 271–285 per share, aiming to raise over Rs 301 crore through a fresh issue and an offer for sale. The company plans to use the proceeds to expand manufacturing capacity, install rooftop solar systems, repay debt, and support general corporate purposes.

items.title: Bonus issue alert! This smallcap infra stock that jumped 50% in a month has declared 1:1 bonus issue
items.description: Chavda Infra has announced a 1:1 bonus issue, with shareholders set to receive one additional share for every share held. The Ahmedabad-based infrastructure company’s stock has surged 53% in a month and 71% from its 52-week low, taking its market capitalisation above Rs 439 crore.

items.title: Samvardhana Motherson shares rally over 7% after Q1 earnings; Motilal Oswal, Nomura weigh in
items.description: Samvardhana Motherson International shares surged after the company posted record Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹35,244 crore (up 17% YoY) and a 70.1% YoY jump in profit after tax to ₹1,032 crore, aided by recent acquisitions — including Shenzhen Autocruis and the Wiring Harness businesses of Nexans Autoelectric and Yutaka Giken — expected to add nearly $2 billion in annualized revenue.

items.title: Old strategies buried alive: How CAS hit Dalal Street traders
items.description: The new closing auction session (CAS) has rattled Dalal Street, with traders saying long-standing strategies are no longer working. SEBI, however, remains confident the system will improve as participation rises. Weak liquidity and volatile closing prices have intensified concerns, forcing traders and brokerages to adapt to the new market mechanism.

items.title: Crompton Greaves shares crash 7% despite strong Q1 results
items.description: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals shares fell to a day's low of ₹250 on Friday, even after posting strong Q1 results a day earlier. The company reported a 15.2% YoY jump in PAT to ₹143 crore (6.4% margin) and 11.8% YoY revenue growth to ₹2,235 crore, driven by broad-based performance across segments.

items.title: AI frenzy spooks investors but JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon says spending boom likely to pay off. Here's why
items.description: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon believes massive capital expenditure in artificial intelligence by hyperscalers will ultimately pay off despite market anxiety. Speaking to CNBC, Dimon noted that AI infrastructure demand is driving US economic growth and GDP, though individual data centre project risks require careful case-by-case analysis.

items.title: Suzlon Energy shares rise after US judge directs Pentagon to lift wind project freeze
items.description: Suzlon Energy shares rose after a U.S. judge ordered the Pentagon to lift its freeze on reviewing onshore wind projects. According to Reuters, U.S. District Judge Karin Immergut granted a preliminary injunction sought by renewable energy groups, who said the freeze had caused a "total halt" in wind project development across the country.

items.title: Closing Auction Session: Why Sebi says the new framework is better than VWAP
items.description: Sebi has defended the new Closing Auction Session (CAS), saying it offers better price discovery and execution certainty than the earlier VWAP-based system. The regulator said CAS aligns Indian markets with global practices and aims to reduce price disruption. Traders, however, remain concerned about unpredictable closing prices and risk management.

items.title: Ixigo posts record Q1 profit, but stock tumbles 9%. Here's what worried Dalal Street
items.description: Ixigo shares fell nearly 9% despite the online travel company reporting its highest-ever quarterly profit in Q1FY27. The stock came under pressure after brokerages turned cautious, citing continued investments in hotels, AI and other growth initiatives that could weigh on near-term profitability. Shares later pared losses but remained down over 8% during Friday’s session.

items.title: Godrej Consumer shares slide 4% after Q1 margin falls amid commodity inflation; Rs 5/share dividend declared
items.description: Godrej Consumer Products shares fell 4.3% after the FMCG major reported its June quarter results. Consolidated net profit rose 12% year-on-year to Rs 505 crore, while revenue from operations increased 18% to Rs 4,225 crore. Despite healthy growth, the stock declined as investors reacted to the quarterly performance.

items.title: Adani Green Energy shares can rally up to 23%. Why Axis Capital, Elara initiated coverage
items.description: Brokerages Axis Capital and Elara Capital initiated coverage on Adani Green Energy, citing its ambitious plan to expand renewable energy capacity to 50 GW and strong long-term growth prospects. The firms see up to 23% upside, backed by robust capacity additions, improving cash flows and India's accelerating clean energy transition.

items.title: Global equity funds extend inflow streak to 11 weeks as earnings optimism lifts risk appetite
items.description: Global equity funds extended their inflow streak to 11 weeks, attracting $21.15 billion in the week ended August 5. Strong corporate earnings and easing crude prices boosted risk appetite. European and Asian equity funds led regional inflows, while emerging market equities saw their strongest weekly inflows in over five months.

items.title: SBI share price climbs 4% after Q1 profit jumps 10% YoY, beats estimates
items.description: SBI shares rose sharply on Friday after the lender reported a 10% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 standalone profit to Rs 21,121 crore, beating Street estimates. Net interest income rose 15% to Rs 46,992 crore, while total business crossed Rs 110 trillion. The stock remains 9% below its 52-week high.
